title: The Muses Urania and Calliope
alt: Two women in blue, pink and yellow robes sit on the ground at the foot of a stone building. One, with six silver stars on her diadem, leans on a silver sphere; the other holds a book in her lap, with the partial word 'odiss' written on the edges of its pages. Three winged putti fly nearby holding up crowns of leaves, and a landscape of green hills and blue mountains stretches away to the right.

title: Ulysses
alt: A man's upper body and face, seen from below and in profile, facing right. He has a thick dark beard and curly dark hair under a yellow helmet tipped up on his head, wears a reddish-orange garment, and holds his left hand, in shadow, clenched against his chest, against a muted background of yellows and greens.

title: The Feast of the Gods
alt: Six women, eight men, two satyrs with goat's legs and a child gather in pairs and trios in a loose row across a rocky, wooded landscape. Most wear loose robes in white, blue, green, coral and pink. On the ground in front lie a wooden bucket, a glass goblet, a pitchfork, a blue and white dish of grapes and an overturned cup. Craggy cliffs rise on the left and dark trees on the right under a blue sky.

title: The Judgment of Paris
alt: In the lower left of a vast landscape, a young man in red drapery sits on a rock with a staff and points at three women near a cave. One, in red and blue, stands beside a peacock with its tail fanned; one holds a white cloth beside a winged child with arrows; one sits on a yellow-draped rock beside a lance and a helmet with a red feather. Sheep graze in front, tall trees and a waterfall are on the left, and water winds towards purple mountains under a blue sky.
